headline: Nagreeka Exports submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Nagreeka Exports
summary: Nagreeka Exports Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing confirming the outcome of shareholder resolutions. The submission contains standard procedural updates without any unexpected corporate announcements. Indian retail investors holding the stock see no immediate material impact on share price or business operations.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no direct consequence for retail investors.
